violations.text: Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
Dishes and utensils were observed in the servers line hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
Lettuce was observed wilted and moldy. PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

( Various food product ) was observed held at (47-68 ) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Various food product was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the (all) refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Working containers of (dry and liquid ingredients) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
Open packages of ham and cheese left uncovered in the 2 dr reach in. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (cutting board) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

(2 Dr Reach in ) located in the (kitchen ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 52-55 DF. Establishment not allowed to store any TCS food in units until repaired and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

Wood is used in the construction of (support beans) in the (walk in cooler ) area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces of the have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -liquid ingredient containers -prep table shelves -steam table shelves -equipment shelves -interior and exterior of all refrigeration units New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026
The following equipment is in poor repair:-leakage at plumbing under 3 bay sink-faucet head at 3 aby sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The condensate from the 2 dr reach and walk in refrigeration unit is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026
The (ceilings ) in the (walk in cooler ) area is in poor repair. Observed detaching from surface. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility including walk in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (basement ) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the counter area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024
Container were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024

(Various prepared foods ) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024

The door to the outside, located in the (front and back of establishment ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/20/2024
Inspector observed food be stored in non food grade buckets and single use containers. PIC informed to cease practice. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024
(Chest freezer ) located in the (kitchen) area was not in good repair. Hood doesn't close tightly. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024

Wood is used in the construction of storage shelves in the hot holding area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine ) sanitizing solution for the (3 bay sink ). New Violation. Correct By: 12/20/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the (steam table shelves, 2 dr reach in, and food storage shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 12/20/2024

The floors in basement walk in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024

Wood is used in the construction of storage shelves in the hot holding area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 03/26/2024
